player_prompt.intro:
Iwe mche {player_id} mu mlambi wa HighSociety (mbali ya 2 wache).
Moto wa mlambi:  Kadi 10 za prestige zikuzindikira moja mwamsanga.
Kukhudza:    Mu zindikiri zilizonso, chonde kadi ya ndalama 1-11 na ionekereze.
            • Kukhudza kwa kuwala kunawina kadi ya prestige na kuyika kadi ya ndalama.
            • Kukhudza kwa chifukwa chinachititsa kadi ya ndalama.
            • Kukhudza kwa usawa -> kukhudzwa zonse zikabalisidwe na kadi ya prestige iyeyo ikuzindikire.
Kupimira:    Pambali za zindikiri zonse, onaninso **ndalama zilizobaki + pointi za prestige**.
            *Net-worth* iliyo pafupi inawina (kuzindikira kwa usawa -> kuzindikira).

**Syntax ya Ngozi**  →  khudza kadi moja kama '[7]' au '[11]'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Funikire kupeza kadi ya ndalama iyeyo [X].
invalid_move.card_not_held: Simulinso ndi khadi la ndalama limenelo.

message.auction_result: P0 wakhudza {bid0}, P1 wakhudza {bid1}. Mche {winner} anawina prestige {prize} (jumla {total}).

outcome.draw: Onse awiri ali ndi ndalama zokwana {nw0}  zofanana ndendende.
